sentences.zh: 主上春秋高，大業須有所付；

translations.literal: Our lord's years are advanced; the great enterprise must be entrusted to someone;
translations.idiomatic: Our lord's years are advanced, and the great enterprise must be entrusted to someone;

sentences.zh: 武氏諸王非所屬意。

translations.literal: The princes of the Wu clan are not those in whom she trusts her heart.
translations.idiomatic: the princes of the Wu clan are not those in whom her heart rests.

sentences.zh: 公何不從容勸主上立廬陵王以系蒼生之望！

translations.literal: Why do you not calmly advise our lord to install the Prince of Luling to bind the hopes of the people!
translations.idiomatic: Why not calmly urge our lord to establish the Prince of Luling and bind the people's hopes!

sentences.zh: 如此，豈徒免禍，亦可以長保富貴矣。」

translations.literal: If you do this, would you merely escape disaster—you could long preserve wealth and honor as well."
translations.idiomatic: If you do this, you will not merely escape disaster—you can long preserve your wealth and rank."

sentences.zh: 二人以為然，承間屢為太后言之。

translations.literal: The two thought this right and, seizing opportunities, repeatedly spoke of it to the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: The two agreed, and whenever they found an opening they repeatedly urged this on the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 太后知謀出於頊，乃召問之，頊復為太后具陳利害，太后意乃定。

translations.literal: When the Empress Dowager learned the scheme came from Xu, she summoned and questioned him; Xu again fully set forth advantages and harms to the Empress Dowager, and her mind was then decided.
translations.idiomatic: When the Empress Dowager learned the plan came from Xu, she summoned and questioned him. Xu again laid out the advantages and risks in full, and her mind was made up.

sentences.zh: 三月，己巳，託言廬陵王有疾，遣職方員外郎瑕丘徐彥伯召廬陵王及其妃、諸子詣行在療疾。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jisi, under the pretense that the Prince of Luling was ill, she dispatched Bureau of Personnel External Official Xu Yanbo of Xiuqiu to summon the Prince of Luling, his consort, and his sons to the imperial camp for treatment.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jisi, claiming that the Prince of Luling was ill, she sent Bureau of Personnel External Official Xu Yanbo of Xiuqiu to summon the Prince of Luling, his consort, and his sons to the imperial residence for medical care.

sentences.zh: 戊子，廬陵王至神都。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the Prince of Luling reached Shendu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the Prince of Luling arrived at Shendu.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，庚寅朔，太后祀太廟。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the gengyin new moon, the Empress Dowager sacrificed at the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the gengyin new moon, the Empress Dowager offered sacrifice at the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以婁師德充隴右諸軍大使，仍檢校營田事。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Lou Shide was made Commissioner over the various armies of Longyou, while still acting as inspector of garrison-agriculture affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Lou Shide was appointed Commissioner over the armies of Longyou, while continuing to oversee garrison-agriculture affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月，甲午，命淮陽王武延秀下突厥，納默啜女為妃；

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiawu, Prince Wu Yanxiu of Huaiyang was ordered to go down to the Turks and take Mokuan's daughter as consort;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiawu, Prince Wu Yanxiu of Huaiyang was ordered to go to the Turks and take Mokuan's daughter as his bride;

sentences.zh: 豹韜衛大將軍閻知微攝春官尚書，右武衛郎將楊齊莊攝司賓卿，繼金帛巨億以送之。

translations.literal: Leopard-Bow Guard General Yan Zhiwei acted as Minister of Spring Offices, Right Martial Guard Commandant Yang Qizhuang acted as Director of Ceremonial Reception, and they followed with vast stores of gold, silk, and cloth to escort him.
translations.idiomatic: Leopard-Bow Guard General Yan Zhiwei served as acting Minister of Spring Offices, Right Martial Guard Commandant Yang Qizhuang as acting Director of Ceremonial Reception, and they followed with enormous gifts of gold and silk to escort him.

sentences.zh: 延秀，承嗣之子也。

translations.literal: Yanxiu was Chengsi's son.
translations.idiomatic: Yanxiu was Wu Chengsi's son.

sentences.zh: 鳳閣舍人襄陽張柬之諫曰：「自古未有中國親王娶夷狄女者。」

translations.literal: Fengge Reminder Zhang Jianzhi of Xiangyang remonstrated, saying, "From antiquity there has never been a Chinese imperial prince who married a barbarian woman's daughter."
translations.idiomatic: Fengge Reminder Zhang Jianzhi of Xiangyang remonstrated, "Since antiquity no Chinese imperial prince has ever taken a barbarian woman as his bride."

sentences.zh: 由是忤旨，出為合州刺史。

translations.literal: On this account he offended the imperial will and was sent out as prefect of He.
translations.idiomatic: On this account he offended the throne and was sent out as prefect of He.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，鳳閣侍郎、同平章事杜景儉罷為秋官尚書。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Fengge Vice Minister and Associate Counselor Du Jingjian was removed and made Minister of Autumn Offices.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, Fengge Vice Minister and Associate Counselor Du Jingjian was dismissed and appointed Minister of Autumn Offices.

sentences.zh: 八月，戊子，武延秀至黑沙南庭。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wuzi, Wu Yanxiu reached the southern court at Heisha.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuzi, Wu Yanxiu reached the southern court at Heisha.

sentences.zh: 突厥默啜謂閻知微等曰：「我欲以女嫁李氏，安用武氏兒邪！

translations.literal: The Turk Mokuan said to Yan Zhiwei and the others, "I wished to give my daughter in marriage to the Li clan—what use have I for a Wu-clan youth!
translations.idiomatic: The Turk Mokuan said to Yan Zhiwei and the others, "I meant to marry my daughter into the Li clan. What use have I for a Wu-clan boy!

sentences.zh: 此豈天子之子乎！

translations.literal: Is this even a Son of Heaven's son!
translations.idiomatic: Is this even a son of the Son of Heaven!

sentences.zh: 我突厥世受李氏恩，聞李氏盡滅，唯兩兒在，我今將兵輔立之。」

translations.literal: Our Turks have received Li-clan grace for generations; hearing the Li clan was nearly extinguished and only two sons remain, I now lead troops to aid and install one."
translations.idiomatic: Our Turks have received the Li clan's grace for generations. Hearing that the Li have been nearly wiped out and only two sons remain, I now lead troops to aid and establish one."

sentences.zh: 乃拘延秀於別所，以知微為南面可汗，言欲使之主唐民也。

translations.literal: He then detained Yanxiu in a separate place and made Zhiwei Southern Qaghan, saying he intended to have him rule the Tang people.
translations.idiomatic: He then detained Yanxiu elsewhere and made Zhiwei Southern Qaghan, saying he meant to have him rule the Tang people.

sentences.zh: 遂發兵襲靜難、平狄、清夷等軍，靜難軍使慕容玄崱以兵五千降之。

translations.literal: He then sent troops to attack the Jingnan, Pingdi, and Qingyi armies; Jingnan Army Commissioner Murong Xuanko surrendered with five thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent troops against the Jingnan, Pingdi, and Qingyi armies, and Jingnan Army Commissioner Murong Xuanko surrendered with five thousand men.

sentences.zh: 虜勢大振，進寇媯、檀等州。

translations.literal: The barbarians' momentum greatly surged and they advanced to raid Gui, Tan, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The barbarians' strength greatly swelled, and they pressed forward to raid Gui, Tan, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 前從閻知微入突厥者，默啜皆賜之五品、三品之服，太后悉奪之。

translations.literal: Those who had previously accompanied Yan Zhiwei into the Turks—Mokuan had given them all fifth- and third-rank robes—the Empress Dowager stripped them all away.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had earlier followed Yan Zhiwei into the Turks had all been given fifth- and third-rank robes by Mokuan; the Empress Dowager stripped them of those honors.

sentences.zh: 默啜移書數朝廷曰：「與我蒸谷種，種之不生，一也。

translations.literal: Mokuan sent a letter enumerating charges against the court, saying, "You gave me steamed grain seed—it would not sprout when planted—that is one.
translations.idiomatic: Mokuan sent a letter listing grievances against the court: "You gave me steamed grain seed that would not sprout when planted—that is the first.

sentences.zh: 金銀器皆行濫，非真物，二也。

translations.literal: Gold and silver vessels were all shoddy, not genuine—that is two.
translations.idiomatic: Your gold and silver vessels were all shoddy, not genuine—that is the second.

sentences.zh: 我與使者緋紫皆奪之，三也。

translations.literal: The scarlet and purple robes you gave me and my envoys were all taken away—that is three.
translations.idiomatic: The scarlet and purple robes you gave me and my envoys were all taken back—that is the third.

sentences.zh: 繒帛皆疏惡，四也。

translations.literal: Silks and cloth were all coarse and poor—that is four.
translations.idiomatic: Your silks and cloth were all coarse and inferior—that is the fourth.

sentences.zh: 我可汗女當嫁天子兒，武氏小姓，門戶不敵，罔冒為昏，五也。

translations.literal: My qaghan daughter should marry a Son of Heaven's son; the Wu are a petty surname, their gates do not match—this was a false marriage in fraud—that is five.
translations.idiomatic: My qaghan's daughter should marry a son of the Son of Heaven. The Wu are a petty clan, their house unequal to ours—you passed off a false marriage. That is the fifth.

sentences.zh: 我為此起兵，欲取河北耳。」

translations.literal: For these reasons I raised troops—I mean to take Hebei, that is all."
translations.idiomatic: For these reasons I have raised troops. I mean to take Hebei, nothing more."

sentences.zh: 監察御史裴懷古從閻知微入突厥，默啜欲官之，不受。

translations.literal: Supervising Censor Pei Huaigu accompanied Yan Zhiwei into the Turks; Mokuan wished to office him but he would not accept.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Censor Pei Huaigu had accompanied Yan Zhiwei into the Turks. Mokuan wished to give him office, but he refused.

sentences.zh: 囚，將殺之，逃歸；

translations.literal: Imprisoned and about to be killed, he fled back;
translations.idiomatic: Imprisoned and about to be executed, he escaped and fled home;

sentences.zh: 抵晉陽，形容羸瘁。

translations.literal: When he reached Jinyang, his appearance was wasted and haggard.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Jinyang, he was wasted and haggard in appearance.

sentences.zh: 突騎噪聚，以為間諜，欲取其首以求功。

translations.literal: Light cavalry clamored and gathered, taking him for a spy and wanting his head to claim merit.
translations.idiomatic: Light cavalry gathered in uproar, took him for a spy, and wanted his head to claim merit.

sentences.zh: 有果毅嘗為人所枉，懷古按直之，大呼曰：「裴御史也！」

translations.literal: A guoyi officer who had once been wronged by someone—Huaigu had investigated and righted the injustice—cried out loudly, "It is Censor Pei!"
translations.idiomatic: A guoyi officer who had once been wronged—Huaigu had investigated and cleared him—shouted, "It is Censor Pei!"

sentences.zh: 救之，得全。

translations.literal: They rescued him and he was spared.
translations.idiomatic: They rescued him, and he was spared.

sentences.zh: 至都，引見，遷祠部員外郎。

translations.literal: When he reached the capital he was granted audience and promoted to External Official of the Bureau of Ancestral Rites.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached the capital he was granted audience and promoted to External Official in the Bureau of Ancestral Rites.

sentences.zh: 時諸州聞突厥入寇，方秋，爭發民修城。

translations.literal: At this time, when the prefectures heard the Turks had invaded, it being autumn, they competed to levy people to repair walls.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, when the prefectures heard the Turks had invaded, it being autumn they all rushed to levy people to repair city walls.

sentences.zh: 衛州刺史太平敬暉謂僚屬曰：「吾聞金湯非粟不守，奈何捨收穫而事城郭乎？」

translations.literal: Weizhou Prefect Jinghui of Taiping said to his staff, "I have heard that gold ramparts and moats cannot be held without grain—why abandon the harvest to attend to walls and cities?"
translations.idiomatic: Weizhou Prefect Jinghui of Taiping said to his staff, "I have heard that ramparts of bronze cannot be held without grain. Why abandon the harvest to work on walls and cities?"

sentences.zh: 悉罷之，使歸田，百姓大悅。

translations.literal: He stopped it all and sent them back to the fields; the people were greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: He stopped it all and sent the people back to the fields. The commoners were greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: 甲午，鸞台侍郎、同平章事王方慶罷為麟台監。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Luantai Vice Minister and Associate Counselor Wang Fangqing was removed and made Director of the Lin Platform.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Luantai Vice Minister and Associate Counselor Wang Fangqing was dismissed and appointed Director of the Lin Platform.

sentences.zh: 太子太保魏宣王武承嗣，恨不得為太子，意怏怏，戊戌，病薨。

translations.literal: Grand Mentor to the Crown Prince and Prince Wu Chengsi of Weixuan, resentful at not becoming crown prince and sullen in spirit, on wuxu died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Mentor to the Crown Prince and Prince Wu Chengsi of Weixuan, bitter that he had not become crown prince and sullen in spirit, on wuxu died of illness.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以春官尚書武三思檢校內史，狄仁傑兼納言。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Spring Offices Minister Wu Sansi was made Acting Internal Secretary; Di Renjie concurrently served as Admonishing Censor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Spring Offices Minister Wu Sansi was appointed Acting Internal Secretary, and Di Renjie concurrently served as Admonishing Censor.

sentences.zh: 太后命宰相各舉尚書郎一人，仁傑舉其子司府丞光嗣，拜地官員外郎，已而稱職。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager ordered each chancellor to recommend one Director of a bureau; Renjie recommended his son, Bureau of Revenue Assistant Director Guangsi, who was appointed External Official of Earth Offices and later proved competent in office.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager ordered each chancellor to recommend one bureau director. Renjie recommended his son, Bureau of Revenue Assistant Director Guangsi, who was appointed External Official of Earth Offices and later proved equal to the post.

sentences.zh: 太后喜曰：「卿足繼祁奚矣！」

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager said delightedly, "You are fully equal to following Qi Xi!"
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager said with pleasure, "You are fully the equal of Qi Xi!"

sentences.zh: 通事舍人河南元行沖，博學多通，仁傑重之。

translations.literal: Imperial Dispatch Attendant Yuan Xingchong of Henan was deeply learned and widely versed; Renjie valued him.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Dispatch Attendant Yuan Xingchong of Henan was deeply learned and widely accomplished, and Renjie held him in high regard.

sentences.zh: 行沖數規諫仁傑，且曰：「凡為家者必有儲蓄脯醢以適口，參術以攻疾。

translations.literal: Xingchong repeatedly admonished Renjie and said, "Every household must store cured meats and sauces for the palate, and ginseng and atractylodes to treat illness.
translations.idiomatic: Xingchong repeatedly admonished Renjie, saying, "Every household keeps stored meats and sauces for the palate, and ginseng and atractylodes to treat illness.

sentences.zh: 僕竊計明公之門，珍味多矣，行沖請備藥物之末。」

translations.literal: I privately reckon that at your lordship's gate delicacies abound; Xingchong asks to supply the humble drug."
translations.idiomatic: I reckon that at your lordship's gate delicacies abound. Let Xingchong supply the humble medicine."

sentences.zh: 仁傑笑曰：「吾藥籠中物，何可一日無也！」

translations.literal: Renjie smiled and said, "You are an ingredient in my medicine chest—how could I be without you for even a day!"
translations.idiomatic: Renjie smiled and said, "You are an ingredient in my medicine chest. How could I do without you for even a day!"

sentences.zh: 行沖名澹，以字行。

translations.literal: Xingchong's given name was Tan; he was known by his style name.
translations.idiomatic: Xingchong's given name was Tan; he was known by his style name.

sentences.zh: 以司屬卿武重規為天兵中道大總管，右武衛將軍沙吒忠義為天兵西道總管，幽州都督下邽張仁願為天兵東道總管，將兵三十萬以討突厥默啜；

translations.literal: Director of Household Affairs Wu Chonggui was made Grand Commander of the Center Route of the Heavenly Army; Right Martial Guard General Shazha Zhongyi was Western Route Commander; You Prefecture Commissioner Zhang Renyuan of Xiapi was Eastern Route Commander—they led three hundred thousand troops to campaign against the Turk Mokuan;
translations.idiomatic: Director of Household Affairs Wu Chonggui was made Grand Commander of the Center Route of the Heavenly Army; Right Martial Guard General Shazha Zhongyi was made Western Route Commander; You Prefecture Commissioner Zhang Renyuan of Xiapi was made Eastern Route Commander. They led three hundred thousand troops to campaign against the Turk Mokuan;

sentences.zh: 又以左羽林衛大將軍閻敬容為天兵西道後軍總管，將兵十五萬為後援。

translations.literal: Left Forest of Feathers Guard General Yan Jingrong was also made Rear-Guard Commander of the Western Route of the Heavenly Army, leading one hundred fifty thousand troops as reserve.
translations.idiomatic: Left Forest of Feathers Guard General Yan Jingrong was also made Rear-Guard Commander of the Western Route of the Heavenly Army, leading one hundred fifty thousand troops as reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，默啜寇飛狐，乙卯，陷定州，殺刺史孫彥高及吏民數千人。

translations.literal: On guichou, Mokuan raided Feihu; on yimao he captured Ding Prefecture, killing Prefect Sun Yangao and several thousand officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Mokuan raided Feihu. On yimao he captured Ding Prefecture and killed Prefect Sun Yangao along with several thousand officials and commoners.

sentences.zh: 九月，甲子，以夏官尚書武攸寧同鳳閣鸞台三品。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiazi, Summer Offices Minister Wu Youning was made Associate Third-Rank Counselor of Tongfengge and Luantai.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiazi, Summer Offices Minister Wu Youning was appointed Associate Third-Rank Counselor of Tongfengge and Luantai.

sentences.zh: 改突厥默啜為斬啜。

translations.literal: Mokuan the Turk was renamed Zhan Chuo.
translations.idiomatic: Mokuan the Turk was renamed Zhan Chuo—a hostile pun replacing "silent" with "behead."

sentences.zh: 默啜使閻知微招諭趙州，知微與虜連手蹋《萬歲樂》於城下。

translations.literal: Mokuan had Yan Zhiwei summon and persuade Zhao Prefecture; Zhiwei joined hands with the barbarians and danced "Wansui Le" below the walls.
translations.idiomatic: Mokuan had Yan Zhiwei summon and persuade Zhao Prefecture. Zhiwei joined hands with the barbarians and danced "Long Live the Emperor" below the walls.

sentences.zh: 將軍陳令英在城上謂曰：「尚書位任非輕，乃為虜蹋歌，獨無慚乎！」

translations.literal: General Chen Lingying on the wall said to him, "Minister, your office and charge are no light matter—you dance songs for the barbarians; do you feel no shame!"
translations.idiomatic: General Chen Lingying on the wall said to him, "Minister, your office is no light charge—yet you dance songs for the barbarians. Do you feel no shame!"

sentences.zh: 知微微吟曰：「不得已，《萬歲樂》。」

translations.literal: Zhiwei hummed softly, "No choice—'Wansui Le.'"
translations.idiomatic: Zhiwei hummed under his breath, "No choice—'Long Live the Emperor.'"

sentences.zh: 戊辰，默啜圍趙州，長史唐般若翻城應之。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Mokuan besieged Zhao Prefecture; Chief Secretary Tang Banruo opened the gates in treason to respond.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Mokuan besieged Zhao Prefecture. Chief Secretary Tang Banruo turned the city over to him in treason.

sentences.zh: 刺史高睿與妻秦氏仰藥詐死，虜輿之詣默啜，默啜以金師子帶、紫袍示之曰：「降則拜官，不降則死！」

translations.literal: Prefect Gao Rui and his wife Lady Qin took poison feigning death; the barbarians carried them in litters to Mokuan, who showed them a gold lion belt and purple robe and said, "Surrender and receive office; refuse and die!"
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Gao Rui and his wife Lady Qin took poison and feigned death. The barbarians carried them in litters to Mokuan, who showed them a gold lion belt and purple robe and said, "Surrender and receive office. Refuse and die!"

sentences.zh: 睿顧其妻，妻曰：「酬報國恩，正在今日！」

translations.literal: Rui looked at his wife; she said, "To repay the state's grace—today is the day!"
translations.idiomatic: Rui looked at his wife. She said, "To repay the state's grace—today is the day!"

sentences.zh: 遂俱閉目不言。

translations.literal: They then both closed their eyes and would not speak.
translations.idiomatic: Then both closed their eyes and would not speak.

sentences.zh: 經再宿，虜知不可屈，乃殺之。

translations.literal: After two nights the barbarians knew they could not be bent and killed them.
translations.idiomatic: After two nights the barbarians knew they could not be broken and killed them.

sentences.zh: 虜退，唐般若族誅；

translations.literal: When the barbarians withdrew, Tang Banruo and his entire clan were executed;
translations.idiomatic: When the barbarians withdrew, Tang Banruo and his entire clan were executed;

sentences.zh: 贈睿冬官尚書，謚曰節。

translations.literal: Rui was posthumously granted Minister of the Winter Offices, with the posthumous title Jie.
translations.idiomatic: Rui was posthumously honored as Minister of the Winter Offices, with the posthumous name Jie.

sentences.zh: 睿，熲之孫也。

translations.literal: Rui was Yong's grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Rui was the grandson of Gao Yong.

sentences.zh: 皇嗣固請遜位於廬陵王，太后許之。

translations.literal: The Heir Apparent firmly requested to yield the position to the Prince of Luling; the Empress Dowager consented.
translations.idiomatic: The Heir Apparent firmly asked to abdicate in favor of the Prince of Luling, and the Empress Dowager agreed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，立廬陵王哲為皇太子，復名顯。

translations.literal: On renshen, the Prince of Luling Zhe was established as crown prince, and his original name Xian was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Prince of Luling Zhe was named crown prince and his original name Xian was restored.

sentences.zh: 赦天下。

translations.literal: There was a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was declared throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命太子為河北道元帥以討突厥。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the crown prince was ordered to serve as grand marshal of the Hebei Circuit to campaign against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the crown prince was appointed grand marshal of the Hebei Circuit to campaign against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 先是，募人月餘不滿千人，及聞太子為帥，應募者雲集，未幾，數盈五萬。

translations.literal: Earlier, after more than a month of recruiting, fewer than a thousand men had been gathered; when word spread that the crown prince would command, volunteers gathered like clouds, and before long the number exceeded fifty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, more than a month of recruiting had yielded fewer than a thousand men; once word spread that the crown prince would lead the army, volunteers poured in, and before long the ranks swelled past fifty thousand.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以狄仁傑為河北道行軍副元帥，右丞宋玄爽為長史，右台中丞崔獻為司馬，左台中丞吉頊為監軍使。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Di Renjie was made deputy grand marshal on campaign in the Hebei Circuit; Right Assistant Song Xuanshuang was made chief administrator; Right Censorate Vice Censor Cui Xian was made army secretary; Left Censorate Vice Censor Ji Xu was made army inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Di Renjie was appointed deputy grand marshal of the Hebei campaign; Right Assistant Song Xuanshuang became chief administrator; Right Censorate Vice Censor Cui Xian became army secretary; and Left Censorate Vice Censor Ji Xu became army inspector.

sentences.zh: 時太子不行，命仁傑知元帥事，太后親送之。

translations.literal: At that time the crown prince did not go; Renjie was ordered to handle the grand marshal's duties, and the Empress Dowager personally saw him off.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince did not take the field; Renjie was ordered to act in the grand marshal's stead, and the Empress Dowager personally escorted him to the army.

sentences.zh: 藍田令薛訥，仁貴之子也，太后擢為左威衛將軍、安東道經略。

translations.literal: Lantian Magistrate Xue Ne, a son of Ren'gui, was promoted by the Empress Dowager to General of the Left Weiwu Guard and military commissioner of the Andong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Lantian Magistrate Xue Ne, a son of Xue Ren'gui, was promoted by the Empress Dowager to General of the Left Weiwu Guard and military commissioner of the Andong Circuit.

sentences.zh: 將行，言於太后曰：「太子雖立，外議猶疑未定；

translations.literal: About to depart, he said to the Empress Dowager, "Although the crown prince has been established, outside opinion still doubts that the matter is settled;
translations.idiomatic: Before setting out, he told the Empress Dowager, "Although the crown prince has been named, public opinion still doubts that the succession is settled;

sentences.zh: 苟此命不易，丑虜不足平也。」

translations.literal: if this appointment is not changed, the vile barbarians will not be worth pacifying."
translations.idiomatic: if this decision is not made firm, the barbarians will scarcely be worth defeating."

sentences.zh: 太后深然之。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager deeply agreed.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager strongly agreed.

sentences.zh: 王及善請太子赴外朝以慰人心，從之。

translations.literal: Wang Jishan asked that the crown prince attend outer court to reassure people's hearts; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jishan asked that the crown prince appear at outer court to reassure the people, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 以天官侍郎蘇味道為鳳閣侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: Celestial Offices Vice Minister Su Weidao was made Fengge Vice Minister and Associate Counselor.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Offices Vice Minister Su Weidao was appointed Fengge Vice Minister and Associate Counselor.

sentences.zh: 味道前後在相位數歲，依阿取容，嘗謂人曰：「處事不宜明白，但摸稜持兩端可矣。」

translations.literal: Weidao had served in the chancellorship for several years, fawning to win favor; he once told people, "In handling affairs one should not be clear; it is enough simply to remain ambiguous and hold to both sides."
translations.idiomatic: Weidao had held the chancellorship for several years, fawning to win favor; he once told people, "In handling affairs one should not be too clear—it is enough to stay ambiguous and keep to both sides."

sentences.zh: 時人謂之「蘇摸稜」。

translations.literal: People of the time called him "Su the Ambiguous."
translations.idiomatic: People of the time called him "Ambiguous Su."

sentences.zh: 癸未，突厥默啜盡殺所掠趙、定等州男女萬餘人，自五回道去，所過，殺掠不可勝紀。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the Turk Mokuan killed all of the more than ten thousand men and women he had seized from Zhao, Ding, and other prefectures, then withdrew by the Wuhui Road; wherever he passed, killings and plunder were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the Turk Mokuan slaughtered more than ten thousand men and women seized from Zhao, Ding, and other prefectures, then withdrew by the Wuhui Road; everywhere he passed, killing and plunder were beyond reckoning.

sentences.zh: 沙吒忠義等但引兵躡之，不敢逼。

translations.literal: Shazha Zhongyi and the others only led troops in pursuit, not daring to press close.
translations.idiomatic: Shazha Zhongyi and the others only trailed him with their troops, not daring to close in.

sentences.zh: 狄仁傑將兵十萬追之，無所及。

translations.literal: Di Renjie led one hundred thousand troops in pursuit but could not overtake him.
translations.idiomatic: Di Renjie pursued with one hundred thousand troops but could not catch him.

sentences.zh: 默啜還漠北，擁兵四十萬，據地萬里，西北諸夷皆附之，甚有輕中國之心。

translations.literal: Mokuan returned to the northern desert, holding four hundred thousand troops and controlling territory ten thousand li across; all the northwestern tribes attached themselves to him, and he greatly despised China.
translations.idiomatic: Mokuan returned to the northern steppe with four hundred thousand troops and a domain ten thousand li across; the northwestern tribes all rallied to him, and he grew deeply contemptuous of China.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，制：都下屯兵，命河內王武懿宗、九江王武攸歸領之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, an edict ordered the capital garrison troops to be commanded by Prince Wu Yizong of Henei and Prince Wu Yougui of Jiujiang.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, an edict placed the capital garrison under Prince Wu Yizong of Henei and Prince Wu Yougui of Jiujiang.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以狄仁傑為河北道安撫大使。

translations.literal: On guimao, Di Renjie was made pacification commissioner of the Hebei Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Di Renjie was appointed pacification commissioner of the Hebei Circuit.

sentences.zh: 時河北人為突厥所驅逼者，虜退，懼誅，往往亡匿。

translations.literal: At that time people of Hebei who had been driven and coerced by the Turks, once the barbarians withdrew, feared execution and often fled into hiding.
translations.idiomatic: At that time many people in Hebei who had been driven and coerced by the Turks, once the invaders withdrew, feared punishment and went into hiding.

sentences.zh: 仁傑上疏，以為：「朝廷議者皆罪契丹、突厥所脅從之人，言其跡雖不同，心則無別。

translations.literal: Renjie submitted a memorial, saying, "Those debating at court all condemn the people coerced into following the Khitan and Turks, saying that though their outward acts differ, in heart there is no difference.
translations.idiomatic: Renjie submitted a memorial arguing, "Those debating at court would punish everyone coerced into following the Khitan and Turks, saying that though their outward acts differ, their hearts are all the same.

sentences.zh: 誠以山東近緣軍機調發傷重，家道悉破，或至逃亡。

translations.literal: Truly, east of the mountains has lately suffered heavy harm from military levies and requisitions; households have been utterly ruined, and some have even fled.
translations.idiomatic: In truth, the lands east of the mountains have lately been crushed by military levies and requisitions; households have been ruined, and many have fled.

sentences.zh: 重以官典侵漁，因事而起，枷杖之下，痛切肌膚，事迫情危，不循禮義。

translations.literal: Compounding this, officials preyed upon the people and seized opportunities to extort; under cangue and rod the pain cut to the flesh, affairs pressed and feelings grew desperate, and ritual and righteousness were abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: On top of this, officials preyed on the people and seized every chance to extort them; under cangue and rod the pain cut to the bone, affairs pressed and desperation mounted, and people abandoned ritual and righteousness.

sentences.zh: 愁苦之地，不樂其生，有利則歸，且圖賒死，此乃君子之愧辱，小人之常行也。

translations.literal: In lands of grief and bitterness men take no joy in life; where there is profit they submit, and they even seek to defer death—this is a nobleman's shame, but a petty man's common conduct.
translations.idiomatic: In lands of grief and bitterness men take no joy in living; where there is profit they submit, and they even seek to defer death—this is a gentleman's shame, but a common man's everyday conduct.

sentences.zh: 又，諸城入偽，或待天兵，將士求功，皆雲攻得，臣憂濫賞，亦恐非辜。

translations.literal: Moreover, when cities submitted to the rebels or awaited the imperial army, soldiers seeking merit all claimed to have taken them by assault; I fear indiscriminate rewards, and also fear the innocent will suffer.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, when cities submitted to the rebels or awaited the imperial army, soldiers eager for merit all claimed to have stormed them; I fear indiscriminate rewards, and I fear the innocent will suffer as well.

sentences.zh: 以經與賊同，是為惡地，至有污辱妻子，劫掠貨財，兵士信知不仁，簪笏未能以免，乃是賊平之後，為惡更深。

translations.literal: Because troops passed through places where bandits had been, these were treated as evil ground; there were even cases of violating wives, plundering goods and wealth, and soldiers knew full well this was inhumane—yet even officials in caps and tablets could not escape it; thus after the bandits were pacified, the evil grew deeper still.
translations.idiomatic: Because troops passed through places where rebels had been, those regions were treated as tainted ground; soldiers violated wives, plundered goods, and knew full well this was inhumane—yet even officials in caps and tablets could not escape it; thus after the rebels were suppressed, the evil only grew worse.

sentences.zh: 且賊務招攜，秋毫不犯，今之歸正，即是平人，翻被破傷，豈不悲痛！

translations.literal: Moreover, the bandits worked to win people over and did not violate even a hair; those who now return to loyalty are ordinary people, yet they are in turn harmed and wounded—how can this not be grievous!
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the rebels worked to win people over and did not violate even a hair; those who now return to loyalty are ordinary people, yet they are harmed in turn—how can this not be heartbreaking!

sentences.zh: 夫人猶水也，壅之則為泉，疏之則為川，通塞隨流，豈有常性！

translations.literal: People are like water: dam them and they become springs; open a channel and they become rivers; whether blocked or free follows the flow—how could they have a fixed nature!
translations.idiomatic: People are like water: dam them and they become springs; open a channel and they become rivers; whether blocked or free follows the flow—how could they have a fixed nature!

sentences.zh: 今負罪之伍，必不在家，露宿草行，潛竄山澤，赦之則出，不赦則狂，山東群盜，緣茲聚結。

translations.literal: Now those burdened with guilt surely are not at home; they sleep in the open, travel through grass, and hide in mountains and marshes—if pardoned they will emerge, if not pardoned they will run wild; bandits east of the mountains will gather on this account.
translations.idiomatic: Now those burdened with guilt surely are not at home; they sleep in the open, travel through the wild, and hide in mountains and marshes—if pardoned they will emerge, if not they will run wild; bandits east of the mountains will gather on this account.

sentences.zh: 臣以邊塵暫起，不足為憂，中土不安，此為大事。

translations.literal: Your servant holds that border dust rising for a time is not worth worry; unrest in the central lands—this is the great matter.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that a brief flare of trouble on the frontier is not worth worry; unrest in the heartland—this is the great matter.

sentences.zh: 罪之則眾情恐懼，恕之則反側自安。

translations.literal: If they are punished, the multitude will be fearful; if they are forgiven, the wavering will settle of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: If they are punished, the people will be terrified; if they are forgiven, the wavering will settle of themselves.

sentences.zh: 伏願曲赦河北諸州，一無所問。」

translations.literal: I humbly wish that all the prefectures of Hebei be specially pardoned, with no questions asked."
translations.idiomatic: I humbly ask that all the prefectures of Hebei be specially pardoned, with no questions asked."

sentences.zh: 制從之。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the request.

sentences.zh: 仁傑於是撫慰百姓，得突厥所驅掠者，悉遞還本貫。

translations.literal: Renjie thereupon comforted the people; those seized and driven off by the Turks were all sent back to their native districts.
translations.idiomatic: Renjie thereupon comforted the people and sent everyone seized and driven off by the Turks back to their native districts.

sentences.zh: 散糧運以賑貧乏，修郵驛以濟旋師。

translations.literal: He distributed grain transport to relieve the poor and needy, and repaired postal stations to aid the returning army.
translations.idiomatic: He distributed grain to relieve the poor and repaired postal stations to aid the returning army.

sentences.zh: 恐諸將及使者妄求供頓，乃自食蔬糲，禁其下無得侵擾百姓，犯者必斬。

translations.literal: Fearing that generals and envoys would recklessly demand provisions and lodging, he himself ate coarse vegetables and grain, forbade his subordinates to harass the people, and ordered that violators be beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing that generals and envoys would recklessly demand provisions and lodging, he himself ate coarse fare, forbade his subordinates to harass the people, and ordered that violators be beheaded.

sentences.zh: 河北遂安。

translations.literal: Hebei was thereby pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei was thereby pacified.

sentences.zh: 以夏官侍郎姚元崇、秘書少監李嶠並同平章事。

translations.literal: Summer Offices Vice Minister Yao Yuanchong and Secretariat Vice Director Li Jiao were both made Associate Counselors.
translations.idiomatic: Summer Offices Vice Minister Yao Yuanchong and Secretariat Vice Director Li Jiao were both appointed Associate Counselors.

sentences.zh: 突厥默啜離趙州，乃縱閻知微使還。

translations.literal: When the Turk Mokuan left Zhao Prefecture, he then released Yan Zhiwei to return.
translations.idiomatic: When the Turk Mokuan withdrew from Zhao Prefecture, he released Yan Zhiwei to return.

sentences.zh: 太后命磔於天津橋南，使百官共射之，既乃冎其肉，剉其骨，夷其三族，疏親有先未相識而同死者。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager ordered him dismembered south of the Tianjin Bridge, had all the officials shoot him together, then minced his flesh and ground his bones, exterminated his three clans, and among distant and close kin there were some who had never known one another yet died together.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager ordered him dismembered south of the Tianjin Bridge, had all the officials shoot him together, then minced his flesh and ground his bones, exterminated his three clans, and among distant and close kin there were some who had never even known one another yet died together.

sentences.zh: 褒公段瓚，志玄之子也，先沒於突厥。

translations.literal: Duke of Bao Duan Zan, a son of Zhixuan, had earlier perished among the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Bao Duan Zan, a son of Duan Zhixuan, had earlier died among the Turks.

sentences.zh: 突厥在趙州，瓚邀楊齊莊與之俱逃，齊莊畏怯，不敢發。

translations.literal: When the Turks were at Zhao Prefecture, Zan invited Yang Qizhuang to flee with him, but Qizhuang, fearful and timid, did not dare set out.
translations.idiomatic: When the Turks were at Zhao Prefecture, Zan invited Yang Qizhuang to flee with him, but Qizhuang, fearful and timid, did not dare set out.

sentences.zh: 瓚先歸，太后賞之。

translations.literal: Zan returned first, and the Empress Dowager rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: Zan returned first, and the Empress Dowager rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 齊莊尋至，敕河內王武懿宗鞫之；

translations.literal: Qizhuang soon arrived; the Empress Dowager ordered Prince Wu Yizong of Henei to interrogate him;
translations.idiomatic: Qizhuang soon arrived; the Empress Dowager ordered Prince Wu Yizong of Henei to interrogate him;

sentences.zh: 懿宗以為齊莊意懷猶豫，遂與閻知微同誅。

translations.literal: Yizong judged that Qizhuang's intent was still hesitant, and he was therefore executed together with Yan Zhiwei.
translations.idiomatic: Yizong judged that Qizhuang's intent was still wavering, and he was therefore executed together with Yan Zhiwei.

sentences.zh: 既射之如□胃，氣□□未死，乃決其腹，割心，投於地，猶趌□然躍不止。

translations.literal: Once they had shot him until he was like a [□] stomach, his breath [□□] and still not dead, they then cut open his belly, cut out his heart, and cast it to the ground; it still [□] leaped without stopping.
translations.idiomatic: Once they had shot him until he bristled like a hedgehog, his breath still heaving though not yet dead, they cut open his belly, removed his heart, and cast it to the ground; it still bounced and leaped without stopping.

sentences.zh: 擢田歸道為夏官侍郎，甚見親委。

translations.literal: Tian Guidao was promoted to Summer Offices Vice Minister and was greatly trusted and entrusted.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Guidao was promoted to Summer Offices Vice Minister and was greatly trusted and entrusted.

sentences.zh: 蜀州每歲遣兵五百人戍姚州，路險遠，死亡者多。

translations.literal: Each year Shu Prefecture sent five hundred troops to garrison Yao Prefecture; the road was perilous and distant, and many died.
translations.idiomatic: Each year Shu Prefecture sent five hundred troops to garrison Yao Prefecture; the road was perilous and distant, and many died along the way.

sentences.zh: 蜀州刺史張柬之上言，以為：「姚州本哀牢之國，荒外絕域，山高水深。

translations.literal: Shu Prefecture Inspector Zhang Jianzhi submitted a memorial, saying, "Yao Prefecture was originally the state of Ailao, a remote land beyond the wilds, with mountains high and waters deep.
translations.idiomatic: Shu Prefecture Inspector Zhang Jianzhi submitted a memorial arguing, "Yao Prefecture was originally the state of Ailao, a remote land beyond the frontier, with mountains high and waters deep.

sentences.zh: 國家開以為州，未嘗得其鹽布之稅，甲兵之用，而空竭府庫，驅率平人，受役蠻夷，肝腦塗地，臣竊為國家惜之。

translations.literal: The state opened it as a prefecture yet never obtained its salt and cloth taxes or the use of its armor and troops, while emptying the treasury, driving ordinary people, and making them serve under the barbarians until their livers and brains smeared the ground—I privately grieve for the state on this account.
translations.idiomatic: The state opened it as a prefecture yet never gained its salt and cloth taxes or useful military strength, while emptying the treasury, driving ordinary people, and making them serve under the barbarians until their lives were wasted—I grieve for the state on this account.

sentences.zh: 請廢姚州以隸巂州，歲時朝覲，同之蕃國。

translations.literal: I ask that Yao Prefecture be abolished and subordinated to Xi Prefecture, with seasonal audiences treated the same as foreign tributary states.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that Yao Prefecture be abolished and placed under Xi Prefecture, with seasonal audiences treated the same as foreign tributary states.

sentences.zh: 瀘南諸鎮亦皆廢省，於瀘北置關，百姓非奉使，無得交通往來。」

translations.literal: The garrisons south of Lu should also all be abolished and reduced; a pass should be set north of Lu, and common people, unless on official mission, should not be allowed to travel back and forth."
translations.idiomatic: The garrisons south of Lu should also be abolished, a pass should be set north of Lu, and common people, unless on official mission, should not be allowed to travel back and forth."

sentences.zh: 疏奏，不納。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted but not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted but not accepted.

sentences.zh: 正月，丁卯朔，告朔於通天宮。

translations.literal: In the first month, on dingmao, the first day of the new moon, the new moon was announced at the Tongtian Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on dingmao, the new moon, the new moon was announced at the Tongtian Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以皇嗣為相王，領太子右衛率。

translations.literal: On renxu, the Heir Apparent was made Prince of Xiang and appointed commander of the Crown Prince's Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the Heir Apparent was made Prince of Xiang and appointed commander of the Crown Prince's Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 甲子，置控鶴臨丞、主簿等官，率皆嬖寵之人，頗用才能文學之士以參之。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the offices of Crane-Control Adjutant Director, Registrar, and the like were established; the commanders were mostly favored intimates, though men of talent and literary accomplishment were also used to assist them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the offices of Crane-Control Adjutant Director, Registrar, and the like were established; the commanders were mostly favored intimates, though men of talent and literary accomplishment were also brought in to assist them.

sentences.zh: 以司衛卿張易之為控鶴監，銀青光祿大夫張昌宗、左台中丞吉頊、殿中監田歸道、夏官侍郎李迥秀、鳳閣舍人薛稷、正諫大夫臨汾員半千皆為控鶴監內供奉。

translations.literal: Palace Guards Director Zhang Yizhi was made Commissioner of Crane-Control; Silver-Gleaming Grand Master of Glorious Blessings Zhang Changzong, Left Censorate Vice Censor Ji Xu, Palace Reception Director Tian Guidao, Summer Offices Vice Minister Li Huixiu, Fengge Attendant Xue Ji, and Remonstrance Grand Master Yuan Banqian of Linfen were all made Inner Attendants of the Crane-Control Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Guards Director Zhang Yizhi was made Commissioner of Crane-Control; Silver-Gleaming Grand Master of Glorious Blessings Zhang Changzong, Left Censorate Vice Censor Ji Xu, Palace Reception Director Tian Guidao, Summer Offices Vice Minister Li Huixiu, Fengge Attendant Xue Ji, and Remonstrance Grand Master Yuan Banqian of Linfen were all made Inner Attendants of the Crane-Control Commission.

sentences.zh: 稷，元超之從子也。

translations.literal: Ji was a nephew of Yuanchao.
translations.idiomatic: Ji was a nephew of Xue Yuanchao.

sentences.zh: 半千以古無此官，且所聚多輕薄之士，上疏請罷之；

translations.literal: Banqian, because antiquity had no such office and because those gathered were mostly frivolous men, submitted a memorial asking that it be abolished;
translations.idiomatic: Banqian, because antiquity had no such office and because those gathered were mostly frivolous men, submitted a memorial asking that it be abolished;

sentences.zh: 由是忤旨，左遷水部郎中。

translations.literal: thereby offending the imperial will, he was demoted to Director of the Water Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: thereby offending the imperial will, he was demoted to Director of the Water Bureau.

sentences.zh: 臘月，戊子，以左台中丞吉頊為天官侍郎，右台中丞魏元忠為鳳閣侍郎，並同平章事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuzi, Left Censorate Vice Censor Ji Xu was made Celestial Offices Vice Minister, and Right Censorate Vice Censor Wei Yuanzhong was made Fengge Vice Minister; both were Associate Counselors.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuzi, Left Censorate Vice Censor Ji Xu was appointed Celestial Offices Vice Minister, and Right Censorate Vice Censor Wei Yuanzhong was appointed Fengge Vice Minister; both became Associate Counselors.

sentences.zh: 文昌左丞宗楚客與弟司農卿晉卿，坐贓賄滿萬餘緡級第捨過度，楚客貶播州司馬，晉卿流峰州。

translations.literal: Wenchang Left Vice Director Zong Chuke and his younger brother Minister of Agriculture Jin Qing, because their bribes exceeded more than ten thousand strings and their mansions were excessively lavish, were punished—Chuke was demoted to army secretary of Bozhou, and Jin Qing was exiled to Feng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wenchang Left Vice Director Zong Chuke and his younger brother Minister of Agriculture Jin Qing, because their bribes exceeded ten thousand strings and their mansions were excessively lavish, were punished—Chuke was demoted to army secretary of Bozhou, and Jin Qing was exiled to Feng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 太平公主觀其第，歎曰：「見其居處，吾輩乃虛生耳！」

translations.literal: Princess Taiping viewed their mansion and sighed, saying, "Seeing where they lived, we have lived our lives in vain!"
translations.idiomatic: Princess Taiping viewed their mansion and sighed, saying, "Seeing how they lived, we have lived our lives in vain!"

sentences.zh: 辛亥，賜太子姓武氏；

translations.literal: On xinhai, the crown prince was granted the surname Wu;
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the crown prince was granted the surname Wu;

sentences.zh: 赦天下。

translations.literal: there was a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: and a general amnesty was declared throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 太后生重眉，成八字，百官皆賀。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager grew heavy eyebrows forming the character for eight; all the officials congratulated her.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager grew heavy eyebrows shaped like the character for eight; all the officials offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 河南、北置武騎團以備突厥。

translations.literal: Wu Cavalry Corps were established south and north of the Yellow River to guard against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Cavalry Corps were established south and north of the Yellow River to guard against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 春，一月，庚申，夏官尚書、同鳳閣鸞台三品武攸寧罷為冬官尚書。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on gengshen, Summer Offices Minister and Associate Third-Rank Counselor of Tongfengge and Luantai Wu Youning was removed and made Minister of the Winter Offices.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, on gengshen, Summer Offices Minister and Associate Third-Rank Counselor of Tongfengge and Luantai Wu Youning was removed from office and appointed Minister of the Winter Offices.

sentences.zh: 二月，己丑，太后幸嵩山，過緱氏，謁升仙太子廟。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jichou, the Empress Dowager visited Mount Song, passed through Gou, and paid homage at the Temple of the Ascended Immortal Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jichou, the Empress Dowager visited Mount Song, passed through Gou, and paid homage at the Temple of the Ascended Immortal Prince.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太后不豫，遣給事中欒城閻朝隱禱少室山。

translations.literal: On renchen, the Empress Dowager was unwell and sent Supervising Censor Yan Chaoyin of Luancheng to pray at Mount Shaoshi.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the Empress Dowager fell ill and sent Supervising Censor Yan Chaoyin of Luancheng to pray at Mount Shaoshi.

sentences.zh: 朝隱自為犧牲，沐浴伏俎上，請代太后命。

translations.literal: Chaoyin made himself the sacrificial victim, bathed, and lay prostrate on the altar block, asking to take the Empress Dowager's life in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Chaoyin made himself the sacrificial victim, bathed, and lay prostrate on the altar block, asking to take the Empress Dowager's life in his place.

sentences.zh: 太后疾小愈，厚賞之。

translations.literal: When the Empress Dowager's illness slightly improved, she richly rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: When the Empress Dowager's illness eased, she richly rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，自緱氏還。

translations.literal: On dingyou, she returned from Gou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, she returned from Gou.

sentences.zh: 初，吐蕃贊普器弩悉弄尚幼，論欽陵兄弟用事，皆有勇略，諸胡畏之。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Tibetan qaghan Qinu Sannong was still young; Lun Qinling and his brothers held power, all possessed courage and strategy, and the various barbarians feared them.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, the Tibetan qaghan Qinu Sannong was still young; Lun Qinling and his brothers held power, all were brave and resourceful, and the various barbarian peoples feared them.

sentences.zh: 欽陵居中秉政，諸弟握兵分據方面，贊婆常居東邊，為中國患者三十餘年。

translations.literal: Qinling held the center and governed; his younger brothers held troops and divided control over the regions; Zanpo often resided on the eastern frontier and was a scourge to China for more than thirty years.
translations.idiomatic: Qinling held the center and governed; his younger brothers held troops and divided control over the regions; Zanpo often resided on the eastern frontier and had been a scourge to China for more than thirty years.

sentences.zh: 器弩悉弄浸長，陰與大臣論巖謀誅之。

translations.literal: Qinu Sannong gradually matured and secretly plotted with the minister Lun Yan to execute them.
translations.idiomatic: Qinu Sannong gradually matured and secretly plotted with the minister Lun Yan to execute them.

sentences.zh: 會欽陵出外，贊普詐雲出畋，集兵執欽陵親黨二千餘人，殺之，遣使召欽陵兄弟，欽陵等舉兵不受命。

translations.literal: When Qinling happened to be away, the qaghan feigned going out to hunt, gathered troops, seized more than two thousand of Qinling's close partisans, and killed them; he sent envoys to summon Qinling and his brothers, but Qinling and the others raised troops and refused the command.
translations.idiomatic: When Qinling happened to be away, the qaghan feigned going out to hunt, gathered troops, seized more than two thousand of Qinling's close partisans, and killed them; he sent envoys to summon Qinling and his brothers, but Qinling and the others raised troops and refused the command.

sentences.zh: 贊普將兵討之，欽陵兵潰，自殺。

translations.literal: The qaghan led troops to suppress them; Qinling's army collapsed, and he killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: The qaghan led troops to suppress them; Qinling's army collapsed, and he killed himself.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，贊婆帥所部千餘人來降，太后命右武衛鎧曹參軍郭元振與河源軍大使夫蒙令卿將騎迎之，以贊婆為特進、歸德王。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Zanpo led more than a thousand men of his command in surrender; the Empress Dowager ordered Right Wuwei Guard Armor Bureau Adjutant Guo Yuanzhen and Heyuan Army Commissioner Fumeng Lingqing to lead cavalry to welcome them, and made Zanpo Grand Mentor and Prince of Guide.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, Zanpo led more than a thousand men of his command in surrender; the Empress Dowager ordered Right Wuwei Guard Armor Bureau Adjutant Guo Yuanzhen and Heyuan Army Commissioner Fumeng Lingqing to lead cavalry to welcome them, and made Zanpo Grand Mentor and Prince of Guide.

sentences.zh: 欽陵子弓仁，以所統吐谷渾七千帳來降，拜左玉鈐衛將軍、酒泉郡公。

translations.literal: Qinling's son Gongren came to surrender with seven thousand households of Tuyuhun under his command; he was appointed General of the Left Yuling Guard and Duke of Jiuquan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Qinling's son Gongren came to surrender with seven thousand households of Tuyuhun under his command; he was appointed General of the Left Yuling Guard and Duke of Jiuquan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以魏元忠檢校并州長史，充天兵軍大總管，以備突厥。

translations.literal: On renchen, Wei Yuanzhong was made acting chief administrator of Bing Prefecture and appointed grand commander of the Tianbing Army to guard against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Wei Yuanzhong was appointed acting chief administrator of Bing Prefecture and grand commander of the Tianbing Army to guard against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 婁師德為天兵軍副大總管，仍充隴右諸軍大使，專掌懷撫吐蕃降者。

translations.literal: Lou Shide was made deputy grand commander of the Tianbing Army and continued as commissioner of the armies of Longyou, specially charged with winning over and comforting Tibetan surrenderers.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Shide was made deputy grand commander of the Tianbing Army and continued as commissioner of the armies of Longyou, specially charged with winning over and comforting Tibetan surrenderers.

sentences.zh: 太后春秋高，慮身後太子與諸武不相容。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager's years were advanced; she feared that after her death the crown prince and the various Wu would not be compatible.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager was advanced in years; she feared that after her death the crown prince and the Wu clan would not coexist in peace.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命太子、相王、太平公主與武攸暨等為誓文，告天地於明堂，銘之鐵券，藏於史館。

translations.literal: On renyin, she ordered the crown prince, the Prince of Xiang, Princess Taiping, and Wu Youji and the others to draw up a covenant text, announce it to Heaven and Earth in the Bright Hall, inscribe it on an iron covenant, and store it in the Historiography Office.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, she ordered the crown prince, the Prince of Xiang, Princess Taiping, and Wu Youji and the others to draw up a covenant, announce it to Heaven and Earth in the Bright Hall, inscribe it on an iron covenant, and store it in the Historiography Office.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，命建安王武攸宜留守西京，代會稽王武攸望。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Prince Wu Youyi of Jian'an was ordered to remain and guard the Western Capital, replacing Prince Wu Youwang of Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, Prince Wu Youyi of Jian'an was ordered to remain and guard the Western Capital, replacing Prince Wu Youwang of Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，吐谷渾部落一千四百帳內附。

translations.literal: On bingchen, one thousand four hundred households of the Tuyuhun tribes submitted internally.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, one thousand four hundred households of the Tuyuhun tribes submitted to the court.

sentences.zh: 八月，癸丑，突騎施烏質勒遣其子遮弩入見。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on guichou, Wuzhile of the Turgesh sent his son Zhenu to enter audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guichou, Wuzhile of the Turgesh sent his son Zhenu to enter audience.

sentences.zh: 遣侍御史元城解琬安撫烏質勒及十姓部落。

translations.literal: An envoy, Supervising Censor Jiewan of Yuancheng, was sent to pacify Wuzhile and the Ten Surnames tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Censor Jiewan of Yuancheng was sent to pacify Wuzhile and the Ten Surnames tribes.

sentences.zh: 制：「州縣長吏，非奏有敕旨，毋得擅立碑。」

translations.literal: An edict: "Prefectural and county chief administrators, unless a memorial has received an imperial edict, must not on their own authority erect steles."
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Prefectural and county chief administrators, unless a memorial has received an imperial edict, must not erect steles on their own authority."

sentences.zh: 內史王及善雖無學術，然清正難奪，有大臣之節。

translations.literal: Inner Secretary Wang Jishan, though without learning, was upright and incorruptible and hard to sway, possessing a great minister's integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Secretary Wang Jishan, though without scholarly learning, was upright and incorruptible and hard to sway, possessing a great minister's integrity.

sentences.zh: 張易之兄弟每侍內宴，無復人臣禮；

translations.literal: The brothers Zhang Yizhi and Zhang Changzong, whenever they attended inner banquets, no longer observed the rites due a subject;
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the brothers Zhang Yizhi and Zhang Changzong attended inner banquets, they no longer observed the rites due a subject;

sentences.zh: 及善屢奏以為不可。

translations.literal: Jishan repeatedly memorialized that this was impermissible.
translations.idiomatic: Jishan repeatedly memorialized that this was impermissible.

sentences.zh: 太后不悅，謂及善曰：「卿既高年，不宜更侍游宴，但檢校閣中可也。」

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager was displeased and said to Jishan, "Since you are advanced in years, you should no longer attend tours and banquets; it is enough to inspect affairs within the pavilion."
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager was displeased and told Jishan, "Since you are advanced in years, you should no longer attend tours and banquets; it is enough to inspect affairs within the pavilion."

sentences.zh: 及善因稱病，謁假月餘；

translations.literal: Jishan thereupon pleaded illness and requested leave for more than a month;
translations.idiomatic: Jishan thereupon pleaded illness and requested leave for more than a month;

sentences.zh: 太后不問。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager did not inquire.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager made no inquiry.

sentences.zh: 及善歎曰：「豈有中書令而天子可一日不見乎？

translations.literal: Jishan sighed and said, "Can there be a Chief Secretary of the Secretariat while the Son of Heaven may go a whole day without seeing him?
translations.idiomatic: Jishan sighed and said, "How can there be a Chief Secretary of the Secretariat when the Son of Heaven may go a whole day without seeing him?

sentences.zh: 事可知矣！」

translations.literal: The matter is plain to see!"
translations.idiomatic: The situation speaks for itself!"

sentences.zh: 乃上疏乞骸骨，太后不許。

translations.literal: He thereupon submitted a memorial requesting to retire on account of age; the Empress Dowager did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon submitted a memorial requesting retirement; the Empress Dowager refused.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以及善為文昌左相，太子宮尹豆盧欽望為文昌右相，仍並同鳳閣鸞台三品。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Jishan was made Left Vice Director of the Literary Flourishing Bureau; Palace Superintendent of the Crown Prince Doulu Qinwang was made Right Vice Director of the Literary Flourishing Bureau; both were also made Counselors of Third Rank at Fengge and Luantai.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Jishan was appointed Left Vice Director of the Literary Flourishing Bureau and Doulu Qinwang, Palace Superintendent of the Crown Prince, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Literary Flourishing Bureau; both were also made Counselors of Third Rank at Fengge and Luantai.

sentences.zh: 鸞台侍郎、同平章事楊再思罷為左台大夫。

translations.literal: Luantai Vice Minister and Associate Counselor Yang Zaisi was removed and made Senior Censor of the Left Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: Luantai Vice Minister and Associate Counselor Yang Zaisi was dismissed and made Senior Censor of the Left Censorate.

sentences.zh: 丁未，相王兼檢校安北大都護。

translations.literal: On dingwei, the Prince of Xiang was additionally made Acting Grand Protector of the Pacified North.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the Prince of Xiang was additionally appointed Acting Grand Protector of the Pacified North.

sentences.zh: 以天官侍郎陸元方為鸞台侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: Celestial Offices Vice Minister Lu Yuanfang was made Luantai Vice Minister and Associate Counselor.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Offices Vice Minister Lu Yuanfang was appointed Luantai Vice Minister and Associate Counselor.

sentences.zh: 納言、隴右諸軍大使婁師德薨。

translations.literal: Counselor of State and Grand Ambassador of the Longyou Armies Lou Shide died.
translations.idiomatic: Counselor of State and Grand Ambassador of the Longyou Armies Lou Shide died.

sentences.zh: 師德在河隴，前後四十餘年，恭勤不怠，民夷安之。

translations.literal: Shide served in the Hexi and Longyou region for more than forty years in all, diligent and untiring; both Chinese and barbarians lived in peace under him.
translations.idiomatic: Shide served in Hexi and Longyou for more than forty years in all, diligent and untiring; both Chinese and barbarians lived in peace under him.

sentences.zh: 性沉厚寬恕，狄仁傑之入相也，師德實薦之；

translations.literal: By nature he was deep, generous, and forgiving; when Di Renjie entered the chancellorship, Shide had in fact recommended him;
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was deep, generous, and forgiving; when Di Renjie entered the chancellorship, Shide had in fact recommended him;

sentences.zh: 而仁傑不知，意頗輕師德，數擠之於外。

translations.literal: but Renjie did not know this and rather looked down on Shide, repeatedly pushing him out to border posts.
translations.idiomatic: but Renjie did not know this and tended to look down on Shide, repeatedly pushing him out to border posts.

sentences.zh: 太后覺之，嘗問仁傑曰：「師德賢乎？」

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager noticed this and once asked Renjie, "Is Shide worthy?"
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager noticed this and once asked Renjie, "Is Shide a worthy man?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「為將能謹守邊陲，賢則臣不知。」

translations.literal: He replied, "As a general he can diligently guard the frontier; as to worthiness, your subject does not know."
translations.idiomatic: He replied, "As a general he can diligently guard the frontier; as to worthiness, your subject does not know."

sentences.zh: 又曰：「師德知人乎？」

translations.literal: She also asked, "Does Shide know men?"
translations.idiomatic: She also asked, "Does Shide know how to judge men?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「臣嘗同僚，未聞其知人也。」

translations.literal: He replied, "Your subject was once his colleague and never heard that he knew men."
translations.idiomatic: He replied, "Your subject was once his colleague and never heard that he knew how to judge men."

sentences.zh: 太后曰：「朕之知卿，乃師德所薦也，亦可謂知人矣。」

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager said, "My knowing you was through Shide's recommendation; that may be called knowing men."
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager said, "My knowing you came through Shide's recommendation; that may be called knowing men."

sentences.zh: 仁傑既出，歎曰：「婁公盛德，我為其所包容久矣，吾不得窺其際也。」

translations.literal: After Renjie left, he sighed and said, "Lord Lou's great virtue—I have long been encompassed by it, yet I could not glimpse its depths."
translations.idiomatic: After Renjie left, he sighed and said, "Lord Lou's great virtue—I have long been encompassed by it, yet I could not glimpse its depths."

sentences.zh: 是時羅織紛紜，師德久為將相，獨能以功名終，人以是重之。

translations.literal: At that time accusations and entrapment were rampant; Shide had long served as general and minister, yet alone ended with his reputation intact—people therefore respected him.
translations.idiomatic: At that time accusations and entrapment were rampant; Shide had long served as general and minister, yet alone ended with his reputation intact—people therefore respected him.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以武三思為內史。

translations.literal: On wushen, Wu Sansi was made Internal Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Wu Sansi was appointed Internal Secretary.

sentences.zh: 九月，乙亥，太后幸福昌；

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yihai, the Empress Dowager traveled to Xingchang;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yihai, the Empress Dowager traveled to Xingchang;

sentences.zh: 戊寅，還神都。

translations.literal: On wuyin, she returned to the Divine Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, she returned to the Divine Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚子，邢貞公王及善薨。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Wang Jishan, Duke of Xingzhen, died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Wang Jishan, Duke of Xingzhen, died.

sentences.zh: 河溢，漂濟源百姓廬舍千餘家。

translations.literal: The Yellow River overflowed, sweeping away more than a thousand households' dwellings of the common people of Jiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River overflowed, sweeping away the dwellings of more than a thousand households in Jiyuan.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，丁亥，論贊婆至都，太后寵待賞賜甚厚，以為右衛大將軍，使將其眾守洪源谷。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on dinghai, Lun Zanpo reached the capital; the Empress Dowager favored, treated, and rewarded him very generously, making him General of the Right Guard and ordering him to lead his troops to guard Hongyuan Valley.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on dinghai, Lun Zanpo reached the capital; the Empress Dowager favored, treated, and rewarded him very generously, appointing him General of the Right Guard and ordering him to lead his troops to guard Hongyuan Valley.

sentences.zh: 太子、相王諸子復出閣。

translations.literal: The crown prince's and the Prince of Xiang's sons were again released from confinement.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince's sons and the Prince of Xiang's sons were again released from confinement.

sentences.zh: 太后自稱制以來，多以武氏諸王及駙馬都尉為成均祭酒，博士、助教亦多非儒士。

translations.literal: Since the Empress Dowager had assumed personal rule, she had often made princes of the Wu clan and imperial sons-in-law chancellors of the Directorate of Education; doctors and assistants too were mostly not Confucian scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Empress Dowager had assumed personal rule, she had often made princes of the Wu clan and imperial sons-in-law chancellors of the Directorate of Education; doctors and assistants too were mostly not Confucian scholars.

sentences.zh: 又因郊丘，明堂，拜洛，封嵩，取弘文國子生為齋郎，因得選補。

translations.literal: Moreover, on the occasions of suburban sacrifice, the Bright Hall, the Luo River rite, and the Mount Song feng, students of the Hongwen and Directorate of Education were taken as fast-officers and thereby gained selection and appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, on the occasions of suburban sacrifice, the Bright Hall, the Luo River rite, and the Mount Song feng, students of the Hongwen Academy and Directorate of Education were taken as fast-officers and thereby gained selection and appointment.

sentences.zh: 由是學生不複習業，二十年間，學校殆廢，而向時酷吏所誣陷者，其親友流離，未獲原宥。

translations.literal: Because of this students no longer pursued their studies; within twenty years the schools were nearly abandoned, while those falsely implicated by the cruel officials of earlier times and their kinsmen and friends remained scattered in exile, not yet pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Because of this students no longer pursued their studies; within twenty years the schools were nearly abandoned, while those falsely implicated by the cruel officials of earlier times and their kinsmen and friends remained scattered in exile, not yet pardoned.

sentences.zh: 鳳閣舍人韋嗣立上疏，以為：「時俗侵輕儒學，先王之道，弛廢不講。

translations.literal: Fengge Attendant Wei Sili submitted a memorial, stating, "The times slight and encroach upon Confucian learning; the Way of the former kings lies neglected and is no longer taught.
translations.idiomatic: Fengge Attendant Wei Sili submitted a memorial, stating, "The times slight and encroach upon Confucian learning; the Way of the former kings lies neglected and is no longer taught.

sentences.zh: 宜令王公以下子弟，皆入國學，不聽以它岐仕進。

translations.literal: It is fitting to order the sons and younger brothers of dukes and princes downward all to enter the Directorate of Education, and not permit them to advance in office by other paths.
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting to order the sons and younger brothers of dukes and princes downward all to enter the Directorate of Education, and not permit them to advance in office by other paths.

sentences.zh: 又，自揚、豫以來，制獄漸繁，酷吏乘間，專欲殺人以求進。

translations.literal: Moreover, since the Yang and Yu cases, regulated prisons have gradually multiplied; cruel officials seize the opportunity, intent solely on killing people to seek advancement.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, since the Yang and Yu cases, regulated prisons have gradually multiplied; cruel officials seize the opportunity, intent solely on killing people to seek advancement.

sentences.zh: 賴陛下聖明，周、丘、王、來相繼誅殛，朝野慶泰，若再睹陽和。

translations.literal: Thanks to Your Majesty's sagacity, Zhou, Qiu, Wang, and Lai were executed one after another; court and countryside rejoiced in peace, as if beholding the warm sun again.
translations.idiomatic: Thanks to Your Majesty's sagacity, Zhou Xing, Qiu Shenji, Wang Hongwu, and Lai Junchen were executed one after another; court and countryside rejoiced in peace, as if beholding the warm sun again.

sentences.zh: 至如仁傑、元忠，往遭按鞫，亦皆自誣，非陛下明察，則已為菹醢矣；

translations.literal: As for Renjie and Yuanzhong, they too in the past suffered interrogation and all falsely confessed; had it not been for Your Majesty's clear discernment, they would already have been minced meat;
translations.idiomatic: As for Renjie and Yuanzhong, they too in the past suffered interrogation and all falsely confessed; had it not been for Your Majesty's clear discernment, they would already have been minced meat;

sentences.zh: 今陛下升而用之，皆為良輔。

translations.literal: now Your Majesty has promoted and employed them, and both are fine assistants.
translations.idiomatic: now Your Majesty has promoted and employed them, and both are fine assistants.

sentences.zh: 何乃前非而後是哉？

translations.literal: Why then were they wrong before and right afterward?
translations.idiomatic: Why then were they wrong before and right afterward?

sentences.zh: 誠由枉陷與甄明耳。

translations.literal: Truly it is because of wrongful entrapment and clear discernment.
translations.idiomatic: Truly it is because of wrongful entrapment and clear discernment.

sentences.zh: 臣恐向之負冤得罪者甚眾，亦皆如是。

translations.literal: Your subject fears that those who suffered wrongful conviction in the past are very numerous, and all are like this.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject fears that those who suffered wrongful conviction in the past are very numerous, and all are like this.

sentences.zh: 伏望陛下弘天地之仁，廣雷雨之施，自垂拱以來，罪無輕重，一皆昭洗，死者追復官爵，生者聽還鄉里。

translations.literal: I humbly hope Your Majesty will extend the benevolence of Heaven and earth and broaden the shower of thunder and rain: since the Chuigong era, crimes great and small alike should all be openly cleared; for the dead, offices and ranks should be posthumously restored, and for the living, permission should be granted to return to their home districts.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly hope Your Majesty will extend the benevolence of Heaven and earth and broaden the shower of thunder and rain: since the Chuigong era, crimes great and small alike should all be openly cleared; for the dead, offices and ranks should be posthumously restored, and for the living, permission should be granted to return to their home districts.

sentences.zh: 如此，則天下皆知昔之枉濫，非陛下之意，皆獄吏之辜，幽明歡欣，感通和氣。」

translations.literal: If this is done, then all under Heaven will know that the wrongful excesses of the past were not Your Majesty's intent but the guilt of the prison officers; the living and the dead will rejoice, and harmonious qi will be moved and joined."
translations.idiomatic: If this is done, then all under Heaven will know that the wrongful excesses of the past were not Your Majesty's intent but the guilt of the prison officers; the living and the dead will rejoice, and harmonious qi will be moved and joined."

sentences.zh: 太后不能從。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager could not agree.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager could not agree.

sentences.zh: 嗣立，承慶之異母弟也。

translations.literal: Sili was Chengqing's younger brother by a different mother.
translations.idiomatic: Sili was Chengqing's younger brother by a different mother.

sentences.zh: 母王氏，遇承慶甚酷，每杖承慶，嗣立必解衣請代；

translations.literal: Their mother, Lady Wang, treated Chengqing very harshly; whenever she beat Chengqing, Sili would always remove his clothes and ask to take his place;
translations.idiomatic: Their mother, Lady Wang, treated Chengqing very harshly; whenever she beat Chengqing, Sili would always remove his clothes and ask to take his place;

sentences.zh: 母不許，輒私自杖，母乃為之漸寬。

translations.literal: the mother would not consent, so he would beat himself privately; the mother thereupon gradually grew milder.
translations.idiomatic: the mother would not consent, so he would beat himself privately; the mother thereupon gradually grew milder.

sentences.zh: 承慶為鳳閣舍人，以疾去職。

translations.literal: Chengqing served as Fengge Attendant and left office on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Chengqing served as Fengge Attendant and left office on account of illness.

sentences.zh: 嗣立時為萊蕪令，太后召謂曰：「卿父嘗言：『臣有兩兒，堪事陛下。』

translations.literal: Sili was then magistrate of Laiwu; the Empress Dowager summoned him and said, "Your father once said, 'I have two sons capable of serving Your Majesty.'
translations.idiomatic: Sili was then magistrate of Laiwu; the Empress Dowager summoned him and said, "Your father once said, 'I have two sons capable of serving Your Majesty.'

sentences.zh: 卿兄弟在官，誠如父言。

translations.literal: You brothers in office have indeed lived up to your father's words.
translations.idiomatic: You brothers in office have indeed lived up to your father's words.

sentences.zh: 朕今以卿代兄，更不用它人。」

translations.literal: I now appoint you in your brother's place and will employ no one else."
translations.idiomatic: I now appoint you in your brother's place and will employ no one else."

sentences.zh: 即日拜鳳閣舍人。

translations.literal: That same day he was appointed Fengge Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: That same day he was appointed Fengge Attendant.

sentences.zh: 是歲，突厥默啜立其弟咄悉匐為左廂察，骨篤祿子默矩為右廂察，各主兵二萬餘人；

translations.literal: That year, the Turk Mokuan installed his younger brother Tuxibo as Left Flank Commander and Moju, son of Gutulu, as Right Flank Commander; each commanded more than twenty thousand troops;
translations.idiomatic: That year, the Turk Mokuan installed his younger brother Tuxibo as Left Flank Commander and Moju, son of Gutulu, as Right Flank Commander; each commanded more than twenty thousand troops;

sentences.zh: 其子匐俱為小可汗，位在兩察上，主處木昆等十姓，兵四萬餘人，又號為拓西可汗。

translations.literal: his son Fuju was made Lesser Qaghan, ranking above the two commanders, governing the Chumukun and other Ten Surnames with more than forty thousand troops; he was also styled Qaghan of Tuoxi.
translations.idiomatic: his son Fuju was made Lesser Qaghan, ranking above the two commanders, governing the Chumukun and other Ten Surnames with more than forty thousand troops; he was also styled Qaghan of Tuoxi.

sentences.zh: 正月，戊寅，內史武三思罷為特進、太子少保。

translations.literal: In the first month, on wuyin, Internal Secretary Wu Sansi was removed and made Specially Advanced and Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on wuyin, Internal Secretary Wu Sansi was removed and made Specially Advanced and Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 天官侍郎、平章事吉頊貶安固尉。

translations.literal: Celestial Offices Vice Minister and Associate Counselor Ji Xu was demoted to sheriff of Angu.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Offices Vice Minister and Associate Counselor Ji Xu was demoted to sheriff of Angu.

sentences.zh: 太后以頊有干略，故委以腹心。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager, because Xu had ability and strategy, therefore entrusted him as a confidant.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager, because Xu had ability and strategy, therefore entrusted him as a confidant.

sentences.zh: 頊與武懿宗爭趙州之功於太后前。

translations.literal: Xu disputed with Wu Yizong over credit for Zhao Prefecture before the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: Xu disputed with Wu Yizong over credit for Zhao Prefecture before the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 頊魁岸辯口，懿宗短小傴僂，頊視懿宗，聲氣凌厲。

translations.literal: Xu was tall and eloquent; Yizong was short and hunchbacked; Xu looked at Yizong, his voice and bearing overbearing.
translations.idiomatic: Xu was tall and eloquent; Yizong was short and hunchbacked; Xu looked down at Yizong, his voice and bearing overbearing.

sentences.zh: 太后由是不悅，曰：「頊在朕前，猶卑我諸武，況異時詎可倚邪！」

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager was therefore displeased and said, "Before me Xu still belittles my Wu clan; how much less could one rely on him in other times!"
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager was therefore displeased and said, "Before me Xu still belittles my Wu clan; how much less could one rely on him in other times!"

sentences.zh: 他日，頊奏事，方援古引今，太后怒曰：「卿所言，朕飫聞之，無多言！

translations.literal: Another day, as Xu was reporting business and was just citing antiquity and applying it to the present, the Empress Dowager angrily said, "What you say I have heard to satiety—say no more!
translations.idiomatic: Another day, as Xu was reporting business and citing antiquity to apply it to the present, the Empress Dowager angrily said, "I've heard enough of that—say no more!

sentences.zh: 太宗有馬名師子驄，肥逸無能調馭者。

translations.literal: Emperor Taizong had a horse named Lion-Chestnut; it was fat and spirited, and no one could tame and drive it.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong had a horse named Lion-Chestnut; it was fat and spirited, and no one could tame and drive it.

sentences.zh: 朕為宮女侍側，言於太宗曰：『妾能制之，然須三物，一鐵鞭，二鐵□，三匕首。

translations.literal: I, as a palace woman attending at his side, said to Emperor Taizong, 'I can master it, but I need three things: first an iron whip, second an iron [□], third a dagger.
translations.idiomatic: I, as a palace woman attending at his side, said to Emperor Taizong, 'I can master it, but I need three things: an iron whip, an iron hammer, and a dagger.

sentences.zh: 鐵鞭擊之不服，則以□□其首，又不服，則以匕首斷其喉。』

translations.literal: If the iron whip strikes it and it does not submit, then use [□□] on its head; if it still does not submit, then use the dagger to cut its throat.'
translations.idiomatic: If the iron whip strikes it and it does not submit, then hammer its head; if it still does not submit, then use the dagger to cut its throat.'

sentences.zh: 太宗壯朕之志。

translations.literal: Emperor Taizong admired my resolve.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong admired my resolve.

sentences.zh: 今日卿豈足污朕匕首邪！」

translations.literal: Today are you worth soiling my dagger!"
translations.idiomatic: Do you think you are worth soiling my dagger today!"

sentences.zh: 頊惶懼流汗，拜伏求生，乃止。

translations.literal: Xu, fearful and sweating, bowed prostrate begging for his life, and she stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Xu, fearful and sweating, bowed prostrate begging for his life, and she stopped.

sentences.zh: 諸武怨其附太子，共發其弟冒官事，由是坐貶。

translations.literal: The Wu clan resented that he sided with the crown prince; together they exposed his younger brother's offense of holding office by fraud, and he was therefore demoted.
translations.idiomatic: The Wu clan resented that he sided with the crown prince; together they exposed his younger brother's offense of holding office by fraud, and he was therefore demoted.

sentences.zh: 辭日，得召見，涕泣言曰：「臣今遠離闕庭，永無再見之期，願陳一言。」

translations.literal: On the day of his departure he was granted audience; weeping, he said, "Your subject now departs far from the court and shall never again have a day to see you; I wish to speak one word."
translations.idiomatic: On the day of his departure he was granted audience; weeping, he said, "Your subject now departs far from the court and shall never again have a day to see you; I wish to speak one word."

sentences.zh: 太后命之坐，問之，頊曰：「合水土為泥，有爭乎？」

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager ordered him to sit and questioned him; Xu said, "When earth and water are mixed into mud, is there contention?"
